correctness.rationale: Unique P1(F_q)×F_q^× parametrization of the punctured nilpotent cone and exact trace-pairing formula give a complete multiplicative-character block decomposition. The trivial block has spectrum {1 once,q repeated q}; nontrivial characters have Gauss modulus sqrt(q) and projective matrix Kχ. For χ²≠1 the determinant-ratio Möbius bijection gives Kχ Kχ*=qI; for the odd-characteristic quadratic character Kχ=all-ones-minus-identity. Exact multiplicity counts cover q²−1 dimensions, all positive. Independent direct SVD tests for eight field orders, including extensions, agree to <8e-15; finite tests are not the proof.
